items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I had seen him in many films but had never seen or heard anything about Shirley Winters

ctx.x: One night in November, I was surprised to see Josh White, the popular folk singer and guitarist come into the club. When we had a break, I went to his table. He was with some English people and he had come to Paris from London where he was working, to do a radio show for B.B.C. He engaged me and the band to do his show which was to be heard at Christmas and we recorded it the 23rd of November.

Another night, I met two movie stars who were in Paris either on vacation or to make a film. I was never a nosey Joe or curious as a cat, so I did not ask them their reason for being in the city. They were Shirley Winters and John Garfield. John was a heavy jucier and he slept in a chair almost from the time he came in until the night was finished for us. I had seen him in many films but had never seen or heard anything about Shirley Winters, who was a starlet then. She was a vivacious girl who liked to dance and…

We also had a visit of Tommy Dorsey one night. I had seen Tommy and heard some of his orchestras in the Apple, but had never met him. Someone asked him to sit in with us and although he did not have his trombone with him, he tried the one that Charles Huss had and found out that it was a good instrument, so he played a couple of numbers with us.
